en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Whenever you want to drink the water at night, so stir the water and say, ‘ O water’,
water of Zamzam and water of Euphrates, I express greetings to both you’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from in a marfu‘ manner the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
‘When you decide to drink water during the night move the water and say,
‘O water, water of Zamzam says greeting of peace to you and so also does water of Furat.’”
